user.title: Leasing contract
user.description: Enter the details of your leasing contract. The odometer entity has to exist in Home Assistant already.

data.name: Name
data.reminder_days: Remind me if the reading gets stale

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, for example the name of the car.
data_description.start_date: First day of the leasing contract.
data_description.total_km: Mileage included in the contract, in the unit of your odometer entity.
data_description.start_km: Leave at 0 for a new car delivered with an empty odometer. For a used car or a contract taken over, enter the reading on the day the contract started.
data_description.odometer_entity: A sensor, number or input_number holding the current odometer reading.
data_description.forecast_basis: Which average the forecasts and warnings are based on. The windowed averages need recorder history and fall back to the whole contract average when none is available.
data_description.reminder_days: Only for an input_number you maintain yourself: Home Assistant asks for a new reading once the value has not changed for this long.
data_description.costs_enabled: Adds the settlement of extra and unused kilometres. The rates follow in a second step.

costs.title: Settlement terms
costs.description: Take these from your leasing contract. Rates are in hundredths of your currency per kilometre, so 9 means 0.09 per kilometre.

data_description.excess_rate: In hundredths per kilometre, for example 9 for 0.09.
data_description.excess_tolerance_km: Kilometres above the allowance that stay free. 0 if your contract has no tolerance.
data_description.excess_mode: A free limit charges every kilometre once the tolerance is passed. A free allowance charges only what lies beyond it.
data_description.refund_rate: In hundredths per kilometre. 0 if your contract refunds nothing.
data_description.refund_tolerance_km: Unused kilometres that are not refunded. 0 if your contract has no tolerance.
data_description.refund_mode: A free limit refunds every unused kilometre once the tolerance is passed. A free allowance refunds only what lies beyond it.
data_description.refund_limit_km: Upper limit of refundable kilometres. 0 for no limit.
